title: device request body github.connect
description: no parameters: the device flow of the GitHub App; token: store an existing GitHub token (a GitHub CLI login or a personal access token) after the device checked it (KOR-25); org_id: a company account of the organization (KOR-47); signing_key: also an own signing key (KOR-47)

app.description: oauth_app: the OAuth App (every repository the account can reach); github_app: the GitHub App (repositories of owners where it is installed)

org_id.description: connect a company account of this organization (requested by an admin): the final answer carries the credential body for the admin's client, which seals it under a fresh epoch of the organization's credential key for the organization's devices, signs and stores it (ADR-078 section 1)

signing_key.description: create and register an own SSH signing key for the account (ADR-078 section 5)

identity_id.description: reconnect into this identity record of the requesting user (same ID, version + 1); without it the device updates the primary record when it holds the same GitHub account, creates the primary record when there is none and otherwise adds a record (KOR-47)
